title: EU AI Act Assessment
headline: Evaluate your AI system’s compliance with the EU AI Act

examples.label: CV screening
examples.text: We develop and commercialize software that screens and ranks job applicants' CVs for recruiters. Recruiters use these scores to select candidates for interviews.

examples.label: Customer support chatbot
examples.text: Our e-commerce platform features a custom-built AI chatbot that handles customer inquiries regarding order status and returns.

examples.label: Credit scoring system
examples.text: Our financial institution developed a proprietary model to assess the creditworthiness of personal loan applicants to automate lending decisions.

intro: Describe your AI system in a few sentences, including its purpose, target users, and affected individuals. You will receive an automated compliance analysis covering risk classification, organizational role, applicable obligations, deadlines, and official legal references.
placeholder: What is the intended purpose of the system, who uses it, and what decisions does it support?
tooShort: Please enter at least 20 characters ({n} entered).
questionsIntro: The provided description leaves a few points unresolved. Leave fields blank if the information is unavailable.

riskMeaning.prohibited: Prohibited practice: placing on the market, putting into service, or using this system in the EU is unlawful (Article 5).
riskMeaning.high: Permitted subject to strict compliance with Chapter III requirements and obligations.
riskMeaning.limited: Permitted. Transparency obligations under Article 50 apply.
riskMeaning.minimal: No specific statutory obligations, subject to general AI literacy standards (Article 4).
